cases.rationale: The crop closely shows an actual elephant's head, ear, trunk, shoulder and legs. The background contains earth and vegetation; there is no pot or another identifiable category object. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A detached actual toilet with bowl, seat, pedestal and open cistern stands on the pavement. A shrub behind it is visibly in a dark planter. The small gray road-vehicle portion at the upper right is too cropped to reliably distinguish passenger car from pickup/truck, so car and truck remain unclear. The other dark containers are garden pots and a trash bin, not luggage, vessels for drinking or appliances. Each frozen definition was considered.

An actual toilet with cistern and closed seat is next to an actual rectangular washbasin with tap and drain. The basin is a sink, not a portable bowl; tiled walls and floor contain no other identifiable category object. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A black toothbrush with a narrow handle and dense white bristled head lies on wood. It is an actual toothbrush, not a hairbrush or utensil. The wooden surface alone does not establish a dining table. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A small microwave has a dark door and control panel, and a white refrigerator body appears on the right. Tall cut flower and leafy stems stand in a clear glass vase; this is cut-stem vase context, not a plant growing in a pot. The black appliance beside the microwave is a coffee maker. The framed wall scene and decorative flower shapes do not establish actual depicted category objects. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A stemmed wine glass with bowl, stem and foot sits on the foreground side table. Bound books are stacked on the wicker stand, and a slim bottle with neck and cap stands on the rear side table. The black upholstered seating is cropped and partly obscured on its left; the visible back, seat and arm do not resolve single armchair versus sofa, so chair and couch remain unclear. These small side tables lack dining-table context. Each frozen definition was considered.

The crop shows an actual uniformed person's torso, bent arm and legs with a cleated shoe. A baseball uniform does not itself establish a visible fielding mitt; none is visible within this crop. The background is blurred stadium material without another identifiable category object. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An open laptop includes its integrated keyboard, and a separate standalone monitor stands above it. Bound books line the shelf. A handled drinking mug sits at the lower left, while a partly cropped white-edged cell phone with black screen and connected cable lies at the lower right. Speakers and cables are not mouse or remote evidence. The wooden surface is clearly a computer work desk. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual zebras have clearly visible striped heads, upright manes, ears and bodies. Their zebra identity is determinate, excluding horse under the frozen definitions. Background greenery, wire and natural wood do not establish potted plants or a bench. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A row of actual pedal bicycles shows frames, saddles, handlebars, wheels and pedals in rental docking stands. The green posts and tall terminal are bicycle docking/rental equipment, not identifiable parking meters or traffic lights. River, railing, hills and the distant roof contain no further identifiable category object. Each frozen definition was considered. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual sink with faucet and drain fills the upper left, and an actual toilet with cistern and bowl is visible at the bottom. A capped bottle is partly cropped at the far left. A small clear tumbler sits on the sink ledge; the thin pale/blue items near it and in the mirror could be toothbrushes, but bristled heads are not resolved, so toothbrush remains unclear. The mirror repeats bathroom fixtures rather than depicting additional category types. Toilet-paper rolls and the wall dispenser are not cups or appliances. Each frozen definition was considered.

The central blue-and-yellow unit has a microwave-shaped door, window and numeric controls. Its colorful retail/toy-display setting leaves actual working appliance versus toy microwave unresolved, so microwave is unclear. The boxed Food Groups items are toy/model foods and printed illustrations, not identifiable actual fruit, vegetables, bread dishes or meat. Printed cookware and other package graphics do not establish actual utensils, cups or bowls. Each frozen definition was considered.
